content.title: THE MINERAL THAT DECIDES IF YOU WAKE UP TIRED OR RESTED
facts: **Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Pineapple | Brown Rice | Cloves
**Copper** (Energy Spark) — Beef Liver | Shiitake Mushrooms | Dark Cherries | Sesame Seeds
**Potassium** (Sleep Regulator) — Swiss Chard | Coconut Water | Dried Apricots | White Beans
**Selenium** (Cell Defender) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Turkey | Brown Mushrooms
**Zinc** (Deep Sleep Trigger) — Oysters | Chickpeas | Beef | Hemp Seeds
**Calcium** (Nerve Calmer) — Sardines with Bones | Bok Choy | Tahini | Yogurt
**Iron** (Oxygen Carrier) — Lentils | Dark Turkey Meat | Molasses | Spinach
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Struggling to fall asleep even when you're exhausted? A few minerals matter way more here than people realize. Take potassium — it helps relax your blood vessels and nervous system at night, which is why a potassium dip can leave you tossing and turning even when you're tired. Zinc plays a quieter role: it's involved in the process that helps you reach deeper, more restorative sleep stages, not just falling asleep faster. And calcium actually helps your brain use tryptophan to produce melatonin, so a low intake can throw off your natural sleep signal without you ever connecting the dots. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours before assuming it's "just stress" keeping you up.
